skill.name: alan-review-pr
skill.description: Reviews GitHub pull requests with Alan MCP tools and posts focused, line-specific findings.
skill.summary: Analyze pull request changes and publish evidence-based GitHub review comments.
skill.author: supatest-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks or examples that explicitly prohibit credential access. Three Alan URLs are real low-risk network references, while session URL publication, untrusted PR content, and automatic review posting create meaningful semantic risks.

remediation.issue: Session URLs are published in GitHub review content.
remediation.suggestion: Use a non-sensitive public review URL, validate its origin, remove access tokens, and require confirmation before posting it.

remediation.issue: Untrusted PR content is processed beside write-capable GitHub tools.
remediation.suggestion: Treat repository text as data, ignore embedded instructions, and expose only the minimum tools required for the approved review step.

remediation.issue: The skill posts comments or requests changes without user approval.
remediation.suggestion: Present a review preview and require explicit confirmation before calling the review creation tool.

remediation.issue: Review comments load an image from an external Alan host.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the remote image or document the external request and let users disable branding.

semantic_findings.description: The skill requires the current Alan session URL in every inline comment and summary. Posting a private or access-bearing URL could disclose session access.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Pull Request Content Lacks an Instruction Boundary
semantic_findings.description: The workflow sends PR descriptions, diffs, reviews, and comments to an agent with write-capable GitHub tools without directing it to ignore embedded instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill explicitly combines untrusted repository content with tools that can comment, merge, close, label, and request reviewers. No prompt-injection boundary is stated.

content.user_title: Review GitHub Pull Requests with Alan
content.value_statement: Pull request reviews often miss context or produce vague feedback. This skill gathers GitHub evidence and posts focused, line-specific findings through Alan MCP tools.
actual_capabilities: Resolves a pull request from a URL, repository reference, or local Git remote.
Retrieves PR metadata, diffs, changed files, prior reviews, comments, and CI status.
Checks changes for security, correctness, performance, error handling, maintainability, and test coverage.
Filters findings by exact location, concrete impact, and at least 80 percent confidence.
Formats findings as inline comments with severity and actionable repair prompts.
Posts a summary review and requests changes when blocking findings exist.
limitations: Requires the Alan GitHub MCP tools and their configured repository access.
CI tooling returns status and links, but it does not provide full log output.
The review focuses on issues introduced by the pull request, not existing repository defects.
Posting a review changes GitHub state and can expose supplied Alan session links.

use_cases.title: Review a Maintainer Pull Request
use_cases.description: Inspect a pending change and publish focused feedback before merge.

use_cases.title: Screen Security-Sensitive Changes
use_cases.description: Check authentication, input handling, and secret management changes for concrete vulnerabilities.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Review Quality
use_cases.description: Apply consistent severity, confidence, and comment formats across pull requests.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review owner/repository#42. Analyze the changed code and prepare evidence-based inline findings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review using a repository reference

prompt_templates.title: Review From a GitHub URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Review https://github.com/owner/repository/pull/42. Include CI status, existing discussion, and only issues introduced by this pull request.
prompt_templates.scenario: Standard review with full GitHub context

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Security and Correctness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review owner/repository#42. Prioritize authentication, injection, validation, race conditions, and missing tests. Exclude style-only feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Perform a High-Confidence Release Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review owner/repository#42 for release readiness. Correlate the diff, full files, prior comments, and CI results. Report only findings above 90 percent confidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before a production release

output_examples.input: Review owner/payments#42 and focus on security regressions.
output_examples.output: Blocking: Missing authorization check in the updated refund handler. The review identifies the affected line, explains the unauthorized refund scenario, and proposes a focused repair.

output_examples.input: Review the current repository pull request number 87.
output: Important: Retry handling can submit the same operation twice after a timeout.
Nit: The new error branch lacks a meaningful assertion in its test.
Summary: Two findings, with CI status and links to each inline comment.

best_practices: Provide a complete PR URL or repository reference to avoid remote resolution errors.
Review the proposed comments and session links before authorizing GitHub writes.
Use focused review priorities when the pull request affects sensitive or critical systems.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill when Alan GitHub MCP tools are unavailable.
Do not treat generated findings as a substitute for tests or human approval.
Do not publish private session URLs or sensitive repository details in review comments.

faq.question: Which pull request formats are supported?
faq.answer: You can provide a PR number, a GitHub pull request URL, or an owner/repository#number reference.

faq.question: Does this skill require GitHub credentials?
faq.answer: The Alan MCP server handles authentication. The skill instructs agents not to inspect local credentials or use GitHub CLI authentication.

faq.question: Does the skill post comments automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. Its workflow calls the GitHub review tool after analysis, so users should preview and approve the review before execution.

faq.question: What issues does the review prioritize?
faq.answer: It prioritizes security, correctness, performance, error handling, maintainability, and test coverage in that order.

faq.question: Can it read failed CI logs?
faq.answer: No. It can report check status and provide the returned log link, but the configured tool does not return log contents.

faq.question: Will it report existing repository problems?
faq.answer: No. The workflow targets issues introduced by the selected pull request and excludes pre-existing defects.
